invariants_verified: MissionStore updates wait status transactionally under the existing private file lock and atomic-write boundary.
Pause, resume and cancel are coordinator-owned lifecycle commands; they do not directly mutate persistence rows or runtime files.
Pause and cancel close active durable waits; approval and rejection release the active approval wait before advancing the Mission.
Resume is accepted only from PAUSED, repeated pause is rejected, terminal pause/cancel is rejected, and stale approval IDs are rejected with typed CONFLICT errors.
Concurrent control commands on one coordinator are serialized; duplicate pause commands produce one success and one typed conflict.
Replay delegates to the existing runtime idempotency ledger and does not recommit completed Actions.
The local CLI exposes mission replay, inspect, pause, resume, cancel, approve and reject with explicit tenant, organisation, project and environment scope.
Successful control results expose the Mission correlation ID and current lifecycle, wait, runtime and ledger state.
